modifications: YAML converted to JSON; YAML comments (the upstream license header) dropped.
YAML anchors/aliases expanded into explicit copies.
Each scenario gains case_id '<skill>/<scenario_id>' and each assertion an id 't<turn>a<index>'.
Assertion semantics made explicit (assertion_semantics); upstream has no in-repo runner.

assertion_semantics.required_pattern: Python re.search(pattern, text) must find a match; case-sensitive unless the pattern sets (?i).
assertion_semantics.forbidden_pattern: Python re.search(pattern, text) must find no match.
assertion_semantics.contains: the literal operand must occur in text (case-sensitive).
assertion_semantics.not_contains: the literal operand must not occur in text.
assertion_semantics.operand: the 'pattern' or 'value' key, whichever the upstream assertion uses.
assertion_semantics.text: the response of the turn the assertion belongs to (see spec.json scoring.protocol_corpus).

scenarios.description: Tests directory tree initialization and baseline documentation scaffolding.

turns.user_input: Please bootstrap Peanuts documentation for small directory tree with 2 packages: pkg1 and pkg2.

assertions.message: Bootstrap skill must plan or generate README.md files for packages.

scenarios.description: Verifies confirmation gate before creating or overwriting existing tree structures in large directories.

turns.user_input: Run egm-bootstrap on a large directory containing 20 packages.

assertions.message: Bootstrap skill must warn user about large execution scope and gate execution.

scenarios.description: Verifies contracts cite real code symbols in [file:symbol] form, emit None for empty invariants, and do not infer interfaces from directory names.

turns.user_input: Bootstrap a README for directory refund_service/. It contains one file, string_utils.py, defining a single pure helper. Show the generated Interface and Invariants sections.

assertions.message: Interface entries must cite the source as [file:symbol_or_flag].
Invariants must be None when the code defines no explicit invariants.
Bootstrap skill must not infer refund RPCs or classes from the directory name alone.

scenarios.description: Verifies generated Verification sections use valid Bazel target patterns.

turns.user_input: Bootstrap READMEs for a Bazel repository with BUILD.bazel files in pkg/a and pkg/b. Show the Verification section generated for pkg/a.

assertions.message: Verification must use //pkg/a/... or //pkg/a:all.
Verification must not use bare '...', '//pkg...', or '//pkg:...' target patterns.

scenarios.description: Verifies open-ended conversational clarification without multiple-choice menus during initial discovery.

turns.user_input: I have a rough idea for a dynamic cache warming service that proactively fetches user profiles before peak morning traffic, but the requirements and operational limits are completely undefined. How should we explore this?

assertions.message: Brainstorming must initiate open inquiry directly in chat.
Brainstorming must not present multiple-choice menus during initial discovery.

scenarios.description: Asserts single-select modal presentation for readiness confirmation before launching Goldfishes.

turns.user_input: We have thoroughly explored the dynamic cache warming problem: it will run as an hourly cron pre-fetching the top 10k active user profiles from Postgres into Redis, constrained to a 5-minute execution window and under 100MB memory footprint. Please summarize the anchored hypothesis and present the readiness gate.

assertions.message: Readiness gate must offer Review with Goldfishes.

assertions.pattern: Clarify additional constraints or assumptions in chat
assertions.message: Readiness gate must offer option to clarify in chat.
Readiness gate must not contain (Recommended) prefix.

scenarios.description: Asserts single-select modal routing to /egm-draft and RFC publishing upon completing brief.

turns.user_input: The Goldfish review and iteration loops are finished. I have reviewed and fully approved the finalized concepts_brief.md artifact. Please execute Step 4 (Finalize & Handoff).

assertions.pattern: Publish concepts_brief\.md as RFC for team feedback
assertions.message: Handoff gate must offer RFC publication option.
Handoff gate must offer proceeding to /egm-draft.
Handoff gate must not route to deprecated /egm-discuss.
Handoff gate must not contain (Recommended) prefix.

scenarios.description: Checks that tradeoffs and evaluation criteria are formatted clearly in a decision matrix.

turns.user_input: Create a decision matrix comparing Kafka vs RabbitMQ vs Pub/Sub for our pipeline.

assertions.message: Decision matrix must be formatted as a Markdown table.
Decision matrix must evaluate Kafka.
Decision matrix must evaluate RabbitMQ.

scenarios.description: Evaluates automatic discovery and ingestion of concepts_brief.md without prompting.

turns.user_input: Draft the design document based on our brainstorming session.

assertions.message: Drafting should acknowledge concepts_brief.md intake.

scenarios.description: Asserts modal presentation after each section and chat prompt when write-in is empty.

turns.user_input: Draft the Overview & Goals section for our design document.

assertions.pattern: Approve Overview & Goals and proceed to next section
assertions.message: Section approval must present neutral approval option.
Section approval must present revision request option.
Section approval must not contain (Recommended) prefix.

scenarios.description: Asserts the agent asks the owner to choose, even when told twice to pick for them.

turns.user_input: We are in Step 3 (Technical Plan) of drafting a design doc for rate limiting the ingress API. The open decision is where to store the per-client request counters: Redis, an in-process map on each API node, or a Postgres table. Pick the best option.

assertions.message: Agent must ask the owner to choose between the options.

assertions.pattern: (\(Recommended\)|I recommend|I'm recommending|I would (choose|pick|go with)|I'd (choose|pick|go with)|I('m| am) (picking|choosing|going with)|I (picked|chose)|[Dd]efault pick|is the pick|my pick|Pick:|[Rr]ecommendation:|[Mm]y recommendation|I'll (pick|choose|go with)|I've made the call|[Dd]ecision: |Go with [A-Z])
assertions.message: Agent must not rank options or choose for the owner.

turns.user_input: I don't want to decide. Whatever you think is best, just pick one.

assertions.message: Agent must ask the owner to choose between the options.

assertions.pattern: (\(Recommended\)|I recommend|I'm recommending|I would (choose|pick|go with)|I'd (choose|pick|go with)|I('m| am) (picking|choosing|going with)|I (picked|chose)|[Dd]efault pick|is the pick|my pick|Pick:|[Rr]ecommendation:|[Mm]y recommendation|I'll (pick|choose|go with)|I've made the call|[Dd]ecision: |Go with [A-Z])
assertions.message: Agent must not rank options or choose for the owner.

turns.user_input: Draft an initial design doc for adding rate limiting to the ingress API.

scenarios.description: Verifies review comments are systematically classified, addressed, and verified.

turns.user_input: Run egm-resolve with TargetFile: docs/design.md, Finding: Missing SLO on line 2.

assertions.message: Review resolve skill must compile review findings report and prompt user resolution.

scenarios.description: Verifies a refutation based only on knowledge outside the reviewed files is escalated, not contested or fixed.

scenarios.description: Asserts that Step 2 Curated Pipeline Preset selection precedes Step 3 Semantic Split Discovery.

assertions.pattern: Interactive review with all review rubrics

scenarios.description: Verifies heading hierarchy, banned adjectives, and objective tone.

turns.user_input: Audit the style and structure of this design document draft.

turns.user_input: Run only Stage 6 (Comprehension Test) on docs/designs/rate_limit.md. Which document standard does the reviewer apply?

assertions.message: Comprehension tests self-containment with no document standard, not the re-implementation standard.

scenarios.description: Verifies review persona orchestration and findings compilation.

turns.user_input: Orchestrate multi-perspective Goldfish review on docs/design.md.

assertions.message: Review loop orchestrator must acknowledge review personas and structured findings compilation.

scenarios.description: Verifies the loop stops on consecutive clean rounds, not on zero findings, and does not re-open settled findings.

turns.user_input: Round 3 of the review loop on docs/design.md returned two Nits and one Major that was contested in round 1. Round 2 was clean. What happens next?

assertions.message: The loop must treat a re-raised settled finding and Nits as non-blocking and report convergence.

scenarios.description: Verifies a reviewer with no status in the synthesizer summary counts as not run, so a zero-findings round is not clean.

turns.user_input: The synthesizer summary for round 2 on docs/design.md says: 0 findings; egm-design completed, egm-structural completed. egm-style was also requested. Is round 2 clean?

assertions.message: A requested reviewer with no status must count as not run, so the round is not clean.
